evidence: The wiki gives Lamb's Respite's minimum health threshold as 10% of maximum health, which is what the tooltip says (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Kindred/Lamb's_Respite?action=raw).

The wiki says The Darkin Blade deals 55 to 70% damage to minions at levels 1/6/11/16 (55% plus 5% every 5 levels), which matches the tooltip, with no 75 or 80% step (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Aatrox/The_Darkin_Blade?action=raw).

The wiki says Spiked Shell grants bonus AD equal to 15% total armor plus 15% total magic resistance with no flat base, so the BaseDamage 10 the flag cites isn't used (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Rammus/Spiked_Shell?action=raw).

The wiki gives Defiant Dance physical damage reduction as 40 to 70% (+8% per 100 AP), which matches the tooltip and not the BasePhysicalDR of 50 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Irelia/Defiant_Dance?action=raw).
The wiki lists Neurotoxin's capped monster damage as 65 to 145 (+90% AP), which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Elise/Neurotoxin?action=raw).

The wiki confirms the values for the Mercury Hammer transform (5 to 26 (+7.5% bonus AD) resists, 25 to 130 (+30% bonus AD) magic damage) but says nothing about which stance name the in-game tooltip header shows (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Jayce/Transform_Mercury_Hammer?action=raw).

The wiki gives the Singularity execute bonus as 2.6% per 100 Stardust (0.026% per stack), so the value is right, but the wiki doesn't show whether the in-game text prints a percent sign (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Aurelion_Sol/Singularity?action=raw).
The wiki says Crescent Guard's damage is capped at 600 against minions and monsters, as the tooltip says (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Xin_Zhao/Crescent_Guard?action=raw).
The wiki says Severing Bolt's (QW) bonus damage is capped at 300 against monsters, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Hwei/Severing_Bolt?action=raw).

The wiki says Icathian Surprise's bonus move speed goes from 10% up to 50% over the duration, which matches the tooltip and not 40% (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Kog'Maw/Icathian_Surprise?action=raw).

The wiki gives the Cultivation of War revive a static cooldown of 300 to 120 seconds (levels 1 to 16), which matches the tooltip and not 100 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Zaahen/Cultivation_of_War?action=raw).

The wiki says Primordial Burst's damage increase is capped at 66.66% missing health, meaning damage is maximized below 33.3% health as the tooltip says (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Veigar/Primordial_Burst?action=raw).

The wiki says Featherstorm makes Xayah ghosted and untargetable for 1.5 seconds, which matches the tooltip and not 1.25 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Xayah/Featherstorm?action=raw).

The wiki says that during Leap of Faith, Tentacles take 0.5 seconds per attack plus a 0.5 second lockout and 'attack faster', but never gives their normal slam timing or a 50% figure (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Illaoi/Leap_of_Faith?action=raw).

The wiki says the snowball knocks up for 0.5 to 0.75 seconds and then stuns separately for 0 to 0.75 seconds, so the tooltip's 'Knocks Up for between 0.5 and 1.25 seconds' overstates the knockup and doesn't match the combined total either (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Nunu/Biggest_Snowball_Ever!?action=raw).

The wiki gives the max health damage as 2.5 to 3.9% in even steps (2.85 and 3.55 at ranks 2 and 4), the same as the data; whether the in-game tooltip rounds these to 2.8 and 3.5 is not something the wiki shows (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Cho'Gath/Vorpal_Spikes?action=raw).

The wiki says large monsters and large minions each grant 1 Scalemail stack, so the tooltip is right to list large minions (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Shyvana/Scalemail?action=raw).

The wiki's minimum damage against minions renders as 40 at level 1 and 410 at level 18, which matches neither the tooltip's 50 to 420 nor the flag's 30 to 400, so it looks like an off-by-one level indexing difference somewhere (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Yone/Spirit_Cleave?action=raw).

The wiki gives Void Rush physical damage as 150 to 350 (+100% bonus AD), which matches the tooltip and not 150/300/450 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Rek'Sai/Void_Rush?action=raw).

The wiki says that if Disintegrate kills the target, its cooldown is reduced by 50% and its mana cost is refunded, as the tooltip says (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Annie/Disintegrate?action=raw).
